title: isolate.
description: a mod that adds weapons such as scythes, bows and more!
body:
this mod adds

- 3 Scythes 
- 3 Swords 
- 1 Axes 
- 1 Pickaxes 
- 1 Bows 
- 1 Ores  
- 5 Materials 
- 1 Blocks
- 1 Landmine
- 1 Permanent Upgrades  
- A way to obtain every item legitemately in-game

working on adding more so far... 
wanna suggest or add your own items? join the discord server (https://discord.gg/bCctGdzRb9) and go to the #iso-mod-additions channel to suggest or add your own item

(i suggest JEI for this mod...)
